text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... It looks like
I'm done for...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...No, at this stage in the game,
I don't plan on making you look after me.
Just forget it...!"
choice_data_list: Don't say that, rely on me.
Don't say that, lean on me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, you really are something else.
Well, don't mind if I do then... The truth is――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I got a pimple on my forehead.
Man, does it hurt.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Isn't there something we can do?

I was relieved that it wasn't anything serious for now, but she seemed troubled by her rough skin.
I resolved to keep an eye on it going forward.
